identification: Amber/honey glazed earthenware jug moulded as Lord Kitchener's face with moustache, base incised 'R.J.C 1912' (Rupert J. Campbell, Launceston Pottery, Tasmania, dated 1912). Likely WWI-era Kitchener commemorative novelty; glaze running and flecks/losses at base rim, no cracks seen.
